title: Constructing/analyzing differential distributed lattices
summary: We restate a process presented by Stanley as a technique to prove that there exists exactly one $d$-differential distributive lattice for any positive integer $d$. This process can be trivially extended to apply to distributive finitary lattices that have a variety of differential poset structures. It can be viewed as an algorithm for constructing such lattices. Alternatively, it can be viewed as an algorithm for analyzing and characterizing such lattices.
